payload.acceptance_criteria:
One JSON state file per session under the kit's orch store: session, project, now, next, waiting_on, state, updated_at (UTC), pid and process start time. It is written atomically. orch state set, orch report and orch decide write it; decide sets the open-decisions list.
orch status prints one line per session, at most 40 columns, with the age on every row. The states are working, quiet (15 min), stale (2 h), dead (process gone) and needs you. The first line names how many decisions wait for the person when any wait. An old now value is never printed as current.
The Claude Code hooks SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest or Notification, and Stop update the state. herdr stays an optional extra writer.
payload.description:
## Context
When the owner looks at the workspace, I want one overview of what each session does, what it waits on and which decision waits for him, so he does not have to ask each session. reporter.py:65 reads herdr only, and orch_relay/messages.py:127-155 (report) writes no state. Lane harness/dev-orch-overview, after the 0.46.6 consumer proof. Orchestrator order 2026-11-19 14:29 UTC (owner go).
payload.title: orch status: a work overview of every session from a per-session state file
